data.one_liner: A highly customizable slide-to-perform-action widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a slide action widget allowing users to swipe or slide to execute a callback action. It supports smooth thumb movement, RTL layouts, and asynchronous operations with loading indicators.
use_when: You need a slide-to-unlock or slide-to-confirm pattern in your UI.
You want to handle asynchronous operations triggered by a sliding gesture with loading states.
avoid_when: You need standard buttons or switches rather than a swipe gesture.
You are looking for complex navigation or state management solutions.
strengths: Highly customizable track and thumb builders
Built-in support for async operations and loading states
weaknesses: The disabledColorTint property does not work properly on web due to color blend mode bugs
Very niche widget with limited scope
